title: German Potato Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting German potato casserole recipe perfect for a cold winter evening. It's a classic dish made with sliced potatoes, onions, and a rich beef broth.
instructions: Boil the diced potatoes in salted water until they're slightly tender. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté the sliced onions in butter until they're golden brown.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the flour and beef broth. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange half of the cooked potatoes in the bottom.
Pour half of the sour cream mixture over the potatoes, followed by half of the shredded cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining potatoes, then the remaining sour cream mixture, and finally the remaining cheese.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with chopped parsley.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
